review_items.decision: Use profile ID rlp.kv-recovery/v1alpha1 as a separate optional stream and do not modify rlp.trace/v1alpha1.

Limit each accepted v1alpha1 decomposition to one host, TP=1, PP=1, rank 0, sample_index 0, one request/lifecycle/pressure-preemption epoch, and one successful H2D restore; process-scoped wait sets may reference transfers from multiple requests only through exact transfer membership.
Use the complete internal runtime request ID, canonical engine lifecycle as sequence ID, positive committed preemption epoch, scoped transfer ID, and opaque logical block IDs.

Accept the base epoch e to recovery epoch e+1 relation and the seven stage owners/boundaries, including worker-observed restore completion, scheduler-observed wakeup, completed RUNNING admission, and a worker model-forward child observation that does not redefine the frozen base compute boundary.

Accept the bounded profile grammar, run/process-scoped exact wait-set membership, profile-specific closed loss ledger, immutable process close receipts, completeness checks, and fail-closed evidence behavior.
Accept the closed requeue reason vocabulary and make unclassified diagnostic-only.

Endorse d2h_preserve, h2d_restore, and transfer_wait as proposed recovery-side operation labels, the H2D mapping fragment, and Draft v4.3 as a dependency; this does not activate issue2:kv-recovery-v1alpha1, which requires a separate content-addressed complete mapping and issue-2-authority approval.
Select the runtime-core OffloadingConnector and TieringOffloadingSpec family with recompute_scheduler_enable=false; do not select the incompatible device NPU spec or RecomputeScheduler paths.

known_incompatible_paths.reason: schedule(self) is incompatible with runtime calls that pass throttle_prefills, and the copied scheduler body lacks current runtime semantics
the device module imports a removed OffloadingHandler module and uses pre-OffloadingWorker lifecycle and SharedOffloadRegion APIs
